sections.Aims and Fit of Module: The main aims of the module are: • To introduce the field of English for Specific Purposes (ESP), with a focus on English for Academic Purpose • To identify and explore the main contexts of ESP work in academic, professional and workplace contexts • To set out the main issues and concepts in the context of the historical development of ESP • To introduce students to the theoretical foundations of ESP • To introduce students to pedagogy and materials development in ESP/EAP • To provide students with practical experience designing materials and teaching in academic or vocational setting • To introduce students to methods for conducting ESP research
sections.Learning outcomes: A demonstrate a critical understanding of the theoretical perspectives and teaching approaches to ESP, with a focus on teaching EAP in the tertiary context; B:acquire the skills of teaching EAP; C:design an ESP/EAP curriculum and develop ESP/EAP teaching materials; D:develop an informed research approach to ESP teaching in classroom and workplace settings; E:analyse English texts of professional contexts for teaching purposes
sections.Method of teaching and learning: The teaching sessions are divided into two components: lectures and tutorials/workshops.
